thread:
sanjay: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's outage — proposing customer comms next steps and owners.

emma: Thanks. Short list please so support can prep templates.

sanjay: 1) Status page language refresh (make it clearer what we know vs investigating). owner: emma. deadline: 2026-03-30. Proposed blurb: ```We experienced elevated inference latency affecting a subset of requests. Root cause analysis is underway; we have mitigations in place and will post a follow-up with full details within 7 days.```

emma: I can do that. Can I shorten to a one-line 'impact' + a 'what we're doing' bullet?

support-lead: 2) Customer-facing one-page incident summary (non-technical) for affected customers and sales playbook. owner: support-lead. deadline: 2026-04-06. Will draft an FAQ and template to push to account teams.

devon: 3) RCA sharing policy: who gets full RCAs, redaction rules, and timeline for sharing. owner: devon + @legal. deadline: 2026-04-13. We need a firm policy for enterprise customers vs public post.

legal: I'll coordinate on redaction guidance. Can we get a draft of the RCA structure?

sanjay: I'll post the RCA skeleton in #eng-postmortems today. Key fields: timeline, impact, root cause, mitigation, preventive actions, owners.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-31 17:00 UTC (30m) — attendees: emma, support-lead, devon, sanjay.

support-lead: 4) Recurring incident pattern analysis (3-month window) owner: sanjay. deadline: 2026-04-20. Goal: detect whether this is a one-off or recurring pattern tied to scaling or deployment timing.

emma: For the status page blurb, can we include a link to the customer summary when ready? that helps CS.

sanjay: Yes — plan: post status blurb now, then update with link to summary and full RCA per policy. Sequence: status page -> customer summary -> public/non-public RCA per policy.

devon: One ask: please avoid technical jargon in the customer summary. Keep root cause phrased in service terms + what we did to prevent.

support-lead: I'll prepare the first-pass summary and the account-specific notes. Adding a checklist: notify top 20 accounts, prepare a CS FAQ, update support playbook.

emma: i'll push the status page edit and ping for review, aiming for EOD 2026-03-30.

legal: once devon has a draft policy, I'll review for contract/PII constraints.

sanjay: Thanks all. action owners: emma (status page), support-lead (customer summary & playbook), devon+legal (RCA policy), sanjay (pattern analysis). If anyone needs to shift deadlines, flag here or in the sync. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Action items logged: 4 items — trackers created: https://internal.redwood/incident/1769001234/followups

emma: acked.

support-lead: ack. I'll drop the template in this thread when ready.

devon: ack, will start the policy doc and ping legal.

sanjay: closing the loop here — follow-up sync notes will be posted to the incident doc after the meeting.
